label: MARKETING TERM
headline: What is User-Generated Content (UGC)?
body: User-Generated Content is any content related to your brand, like photos or reviews, created and shared by your customers or audience rather than by you.
caption:
Think about when someone shares a photo of them using your product, or writes a positive review about your service. That's UGC! It's super helpful because it offers authentic social proof and builds trust with potential new customers, showing them real people enjoy what you offer.
